title: SessionEventPackage
description: JSON schema for session event packages generated by Project Ceres Convector domain

start_iso.description: ISO8601 datetime string for session start time

end_iso.description: ISO8601 datetime string for session end time

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the session in minutes

ics_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the .ics calendar file on disk

message_text.description: The full formatted 'Next Session' message block from Promitor, ready to post to Discord

google_calendar_url.description: Optional Google Calendar deep-link URL for adding the event to Google Calendar
